responsibility: Export the current run/date of both Iceberg Gold products to a committed publication package; does not publish to SQL Server.

interfaces.input: Consumer contract gold_model tables in Glue Catalog + PASSED quality gate; erl_protocol.publication.require_passed_gate.
interfaces.output: Consumer-contract Parquet products + erl_protocol.publication.build_manifest package, written last.

invariants: Export only the requested run/date after PASSED gate; enforce max_product_rows.
Conditional product copy; checksums and manifest commit before publisher can consume.
external_resources: Glue 5.0 / Spark 3.5 / Iceberg, Glue Catalog Gold, S3 publication/tmp, unit artifact prefix, CloudWatch; IAM supplied by Terraform.
state_and_effects: Reads Gold; writes immutable publication products and package manifest; deletes only temporary output.

lifecycle.build: Offline build_artifacts.py --unit glue/export-risk-analytics; own job.py/lib.zip plus selected protocol modules.
lifecycle.deploy: Own immutable script/library keys and Glue definition in project dev Terraform state; deploy only with jobs idle.
lifecycle.rollback: Rebuild/test this unit from the selected Git commit and deploy its compatible pair; does not revert data/schema/state.
lifecycle.remove: Remove routing/callers and own Terraform job/artifacts under approval; preserve shared IAM, buckets, contracts and committed data used by other units.

effective_scope: Exports both liquidity_summary and exposure_compliance for the current run/date to the publication package; SQL Server publication belongs to apps/publisher.
